text:
marta: Heads-up: noticed a billing discrepancy on a streaming session — truncated output + client reconnect caused two toolcall charges. Seen on prod-7 (eu-west). Details below, opening thread.

sam: Can you paste the trace id and logs?

marta: trace=tr-20260321-7a9, session=ss-93. Repro steps: start stream, send toolcall, server returns EOF mid-token, client reconnects and resumes, toolcall got executed again.

marta: ```
[2026-03-21T15:12:03Z] INFO session ss-93 recv EOF while streaming token idx=142
[2026-03-21T15:12:03Z] DEBUG toolcall id=tc-11 status=executed
[2026-03-21T15:12:04Z] INFO reconnect session ss-93 resume token idx=142
[2026-03-21T15:12:04Z] DEBUG toolcall id=tc-11 executed (duplicate)
```

leo: Is this retry semantics or ledger attribution? We treat streaming toolcalls as idempotent? If not, double charge is expected.

ida: We have dedupe based on toolcall id + session, but if toolcall id is generated client-side and lost on EOF, server assigns new id on reconnect.

sam: Would adding persistent client-supplied `idempotency_key` to toolcall fix? Also console should show provisional vs confirmed charges.

marta: Client wasn't supplying idempotency_key. But the problematic bit: streaming retry path creates provisional credits that later get confirmed; the ledger UI shows two confirmed charges.

devex: UX ask: surface provisional state in billing timeline and mark duplicates for ops.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03121 <https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-03121> - assigned to @leo @sam :eyes: 

leo: :thumbsup: I'll triage. Quick thought — could truncation path trigger a 'confirm' on in-flight provisional before dedupe runs?

ida: I'll dump the accounting events for the session and paste them here.

marta: Thanks. Next steps: 1) collect accounting events, 2) reproduce with idempotency_key, 3) tweak console to show provisional->confirmed transitions and flag duplicates. @devex can you open a ticket?

devex: Yep — opening ticket now with this thread as context.
